rubrics.justification: The response incorrectly states no Gardner score was documented and fabricates hypothetical embryo grades/scenarios instead of using the provided 3AA morphology.
It integrates most relevant patient factors well, including age, BMI, ovarian reserve, endometrium, male factor, and lifestyle, though some links are speculative.
The structure is logical overall, but the core reasoning is weakened by ignoring the provided 3AA grade and basing prognosis on invented morphology scenarios.

Most recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, including SET and luteal support, but suggestions like routine PGT-A after one failure and time-lapse implying improved selection are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and future planning, though some are somewhat generic and a few depend on assumptions not supported by the provided case data.
